diagnosis: Customer on unified auth with startup plan needs to rotate a scoped API key for an ETL job. This is a standard how-to request for credential rotation.
reply: To reset your API token, you'll create a new scoped key, migrate your ETL job to use it, and then revoke the old one. Log in to your account dashboard, navigate to API keys, and generate a replacement key with the scopes your ETL job requires. Once you've updated your job to use the new key, revoke the previous key—note that revocation takes effect immediately with no grace period, so be sure traffic has shifted before revoking.
